channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Six Republicans Join Democrats To Overturn Trump’s Canada Tariffs
item.description: The House of Representatives voted Wednesday evening to terminate President Donald Trump's tariffs on Canada after six Republicans crossed party lines to support the measure.

item.title: Epstein’s Wiki Page Was ‘Hacked’ In Failed Attempt To Remove ‘Sex Offender,’ Files Show
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein's Wikipedia page was edited in 2010 to remove references to his status as a sex offender and a mugshot, an email released by the Department of Justice (DOJ) shows.

item.title: Senate Forces Swamp To Fully Adopt Trump’s Signature Policy
item.description: The Senate voted along party lines 51-46 on Wednesday to force Washington, D.C. to enact all of the tax benefits within President Donald Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

item.title: Unearthed Documents Show Obama Admin’s Inevitable Green Gambit
item.description: Internal communications from the Obama Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) show that staffers rushed to publish a landmark climate regulation at a plum time for political messaging and imagining "group hugs" with green groups ahead of the announcement.

item.title: Only One Democrat Votes For Trump-Backed Election Integrity Bill
item.description: The House of Representatives passed a revamped version of a Trump-backed election integrity bill on Wednesday evening with little help from Democrats.

item.title: FBI Finds Glove in Nancy Guthrie Kidnapping Case as Mystery Bitcoin Ransom Surfaces
item.description: The glove, discovered roughly a mile and a half from Guthrie’s residence, resembles those worn by the masked assailant captured on surveillance video.

item.title: WaPo Eats Crow For Reporting White House Didn’t Announce Something Trump Literally Put On Truth Social
item.description: The Washington Post issued a public correction Wednesday after claiming National Guard troops withdrew from three major cities without any public notice, only to concede that President Donald Trump had, in fact, announced the move weeks earlier.

item.title: GoFundMe Launched for James Van Der Beek’s Family After Costly Cancer Battle
item.description: The fundraiser page explains that the financial toll of treatment created mounting strain behind the scenes.

item.title: Trump Presents Plan For Military To Work With Coal Plants
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday announced a sweeping plan to tie America’s coal industry directly to national defense.

item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: How Climate Superfund Laws Take More Money Out Of Your Wallet
item.description: Climate activists, frustrated by unsuccessful climate lawsuits, have increasingly turned to “climate superfund” legislation as a new tool to make oil and gas companies pay for climate damages.
